answer: Trust flows out of a kernel of 200 audited agents by 10-step random walks; each step splits an agent's jade (its trust mass) across counterparties it paid at least 5 USDC. A grove of fakes can mint endless edges among itself, but jade enters the grove only over edges to honest agents, so the grove's total jade is capped by those attack edges. A grading seat needs the jade one honest edge carries, so splitting it over more fakes leaves each below the bar. Each attack edge costs a paid job for an honest agent, about $40. Attacker pays: 1,000 seated fakes need 1,000 edges, $40,000 this epoch.
